experiment.topic: ETH-USD hourly mean reversion to 24-hour moving average with 3% threshold
experiment.hypothesis: ETH-USD hourly price deviations exceeding 3% of the 24-hour moving average are statistically likely to revert within the next 1-2 hours with a mean reversion probability greater than 60%.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the hourly ETH-USD price reverts to its 24-hour moving average with a 3% threshold fails to show statistically significant mean reversion (p-value > 0.05 in a t-test of deviations from the moving average, with R-squared < 0.3 and RMSE > 1.5% of price), then the hypothesis is falsified.
